subject: 东门双柱下五级花岗石踏步
input: First trace is read at x=390 in the 800-pixel-wide scan. Second trace is read at x=365 in the 850-pixel-wide scan. Rows run from the uppermost nose toward the camera.
units: Step section parameters use the distance between the two red column axes as one unit. The sill is z=0.
measurement_scope: Five visible noses set the local section. Scale comes from the combined views of the porch and gallery.
